description_en: Updates a metadata entity. You can update custom entities or objects of the extended table type, such as databases, tables, and columns
description_zh: 更新元数据实体，支持更新创建的自定义类型对象或者扩展表对象（Database/Table/Column）
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-meta-entity --id custom_entity-customer_api:api_001 --comment this_is_a_comment --attributes '[]' --custom-attributes '[]' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMetaEntity

parameters.description_en: The ID of the entity to update. The entity name, entity type, and parent-child relationship are determined by the ID and cannot be modified using this operation.
parameters.description_zh: 待更新实体 ID；实体名称、实体类型、父子关系由 ID 决定，不支持通过本接口修改

parameters.name: id

parameters.description_en: The entity attributes. Complex values must be serialized into a JSON string.
parameters.description_zh: 实体属性，复杂值需要序列化为JSON字符串
parameters.help_en: The entity attributes. Complex values must be serialized into a JSON string

parameters.description_en: The custom attribute values. Each key specifies a custom attribute, and its value is an array that can contain at most one item. To delete an attribute value, provide an empty array.
